DDL	CREATE TABLE tbl (a INT, b STRING, c INT) USING parquet
READ	SHOW TBLPROPERTIES tbl
READ	SHOW TBLPROPERTIES tbl("p1")
READ	SHOW TBLPROPERTIES tbl("p3")
DDL	DROP TABLE tbl
DDL	CREATE VIEW view TBLPROPERTIES('p1'='v1', 'p2'='v2') AS SELECT 1 AS c1
READ	SHOW TBLPROPERTIES view
READ	SHOW TBLPROPERTIES view("p1")
READ	SHOW TBLPROPERTIES view("p3")
SESSION	DROP VIEW view
SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW tv AS SELECT 1 AS c1
READ	SHOW TBLPROPERTIES tv
SESSION	DROP VIEW tv
